findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "demo" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_share_draft · Private data: get_public_product_info, prepare_share_draft, start_demo_workspace, complete_demo_schedule_workflow · Public sink: get_public_product_info, prepare_share_draft, complete_demo_schedule_workflow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_share_draft · Private data: get_public_product_info, prepare_share_draft, start_demo_workspace, complete_demo_schedule_workflow · Public sink: get_public_product_info, prepare_share_draft, complete_demo_schedule_workflow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
